en.html:
Patriarch〝You will settle this.〟
Patriarch〝This good-for-nothing—Akitaka—and House Minato. The bond between them, with YOUR hands you will cut.〟
Chief〝...Forgive me, Kageaki.〟

署長『……許せ。景明』

en.html:
Patriarch〝Get out, Akitaka. The name Minato you will never use again. Before me you will never show your face.〟
Chief〝...Kageaki...〟
Chief〝House Minato... and Hikaru... look after them, Kageaki.〟
